Players Committee card image of [[Meditation (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on your character of ability > 3. Opponent's aliens here are power -1 (and forfeit -2 if a leader, [Maintenance], or [Permanent Weapon] card). During battle at same site, if opponent has more characters participating than you, may add one battle destiny (then lose Effect at end of battle).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Meditation.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Meditation.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
